summary: The note describes Colchester Racing Developments, a company that produced Merlyn racing cars from 1960 to 1979. It was founded by Clive Maskrey and Selwyn Hayward and later continued by Hayward's brother, Clive. After car manufacture stopped, Clive Hayward kept making Merlyn parts through CRD Tool and Engineering Ltd, which stopped trading in November 2015, while he still runs Colchester Racing Developments for components and chassis repairs.
one_line: Colchester Racing Developments built Merlyn racing cars from 1960 to 1979 and still makes Merlyn parts and repairs chassis.
